basic_profile.bio: Avid anime enthusiast hailing from Boise, Idaho. By day, I work as a software developer focused on mobile technology, particularly smartwatches, which explains my frequent visits to the TicwatchOfficial subreddit. I'm a huge fan of 'Attack on Titan' and 'Warhammer 40k', often participating in discussions around lore and fan theories. In my downtime, I enjoy watching Scott The Woz videos and exploring the latest trends in tech. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, around 7-10 PM MST, after winding down from work. I’m currently in a relationship, and we both share a love for anime and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in software development, with a focus on mobile applications. I developed a keen interest in technology during college, which led me to explore more about smartwatches and their integration with everyday life. My passion for anime and gaming is a result of years of following these genres closely, often diving into fan communities to exchange insights and theories.
